//: Purity guard for the isomorphic API layer.
The root tsconfig puts DOM and DOM.Iterable in `lib` for the whole project, so TypeScript
would happily accept `window`, `document` or `localStorage` inside src/api. This config
compiles that directory with no DOM lib and no ambient @types, so any browser dependency
creeping in fails the check instead of silently shipping in a bundle meant for Node.
